item.description:
What's new in 2.27.1

A privacy fix for profile photos.

Profile photos no longer carry hidden metadata

  • Photos you upload are stripped of their embedded metadata. A photo straight from your camera or phone can carry the location it was taken, the device that took it, and the exact time. Dax now re-renders every profile photo before it leaves your Mac, so none of that goes along with it.

Also in this release

  • Signed, notarized, universal (Apple Silicon & Intel), macOS 14+.
